name: Exp_Modified_Optimum_Elliptic_Filter
summary: This EA trades based on the Modified Optimum Elliptic Filter indicator, opening buy positions when the filter values are rising and sell positions when they are falling. It uses a new-bar check to generate signals and applies configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management settings. The strategy is a trend-following system that enters in the direction of the filter's slope.
summary_zh: 该EA基于修正最优椭圆滤波器指标进行交易，当滤波器数值上升时开多仓，下降时开空仓。它使用新K线检测生成信号，并支持可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理参数。策略属于趋势跟踪系统，沿滤波器斜率方向入场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用修正最优椭圆滤波器（Modified Optimum Elliptic Filter）作为核心趋势判断指标，通过比较滤波器在连续三个数据点上的值来确定趋势方向。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]（滤波器上升）且Value[0]>Value[1]（持续上升）时开多仓；当Value[1]>Value[2]（滤波器下降）且Value[0]<Value[1]（持续下降）时开空仓。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈设置，同时当反向信号出现时也会平仓（如上升趋势中出现下降信号则平多仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制手数比例，支持LOT和MARGIN两种模式。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms库中的标准化函数进行买卖操作，包含偏差控制以应对滑点。策略使用新K线检测来避免重复信号，确保每个K线周期只产生一次交易信号。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the Modified Optimum Elliptic Filter as its core trend-determination indicator, comparing three consecutive filter values to identify trend direction. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when Value[1]<Value[2] (filter rising) and Value[0]>Value[1] (continuing to rise); a sell position opens when Value[1]>Value[2] (filter falling) and Value[0]<Value[1] (continuing to fall). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings, and opposing signals also trigger position closes (e.g., a sell signal closes any open buy position). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, supporting both LOT and MARGIN modes through the MarginMode enumeration. Money management uses standardized functions from the TradeAlgorithms library for buy/sell operations, including deviation control to handle slippage. The strategy employs a new-bar check via the CIsNewBar class to prevent duplicate signals, ensuring only one trading signal per bar period.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制仓位大小
parameters.description_en: Deposit share (positive) or fixed lot size (negative)

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（固定手数或保证金比例）
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing mode: fixed lots or margin percentage

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description_en: Maximum price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取信号的K线索引

pros: 趋势跟踪逻辑清晰，使用椭圆滤波器平滑价格噪声减少假信号
新K线检测机制有效避免同一K线内重复开仓
支持独立控制多空开仓和平仓，灵活性较高
止损止盈配置完整，风险可控
使用TradeAlgorithms库标准化交易操作，代码复用性好
pros_en: Clear trend-following logic using the elliptic filter to smooth price noise and reduce false signals
New-bar detection mechanism effectively prevents duplicate position openings within the same bar
Independent control over buy/sell opening and closing provides high flexibility
Complete stop-loss and take-profit configuration keeps risk manageable
Uses the TradeAlgorithms library for standardized trading operations, promoting code reuse
cons: 缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
止损1000点和止盈2000点间距过大，不适合所有品种和市场条件
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在新信号出现时重复开仓导致仓位叠加
依赖外部自定义指标文件，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
资金管理参数MM=0.1含义不明确，缺乏详细文档说明
cons_en: No spread filter, which may lead to unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are very wide, unsuitable for all instruments and market conditions
No position check logic before opening new trades, potentially causing position stacking on repeated signals
Depends on an external custom indicator file; if the indicator is missing, the EA fails to initialize
The MM=0.1 parameter meaning is unclear, lacking detailed documentation
improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，在点差过大时暂停开仓以避免滑点损失
增加持仓检查逻辑，在开仓前确认当前无同方向持仓，防止仓位叠加
添加追踪止损功能，在趋势延续时锁定利润
improvements_en: Add a spread filter mechanism to pause trading when spreads are too wide, avoiding slippage losses
Add position check logic before opening trades to confirm no existing same-direction positions, preventing position stacking
Add a trailing stop feature to lock in profits as the trend continues

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，在流动性差的市场中可能遭遇严重滑点
无持仓检查可能导致同方向重复开仓，放大风险敞口
止损止盈间距固定，未根据市场波动率自适应调整
risk_points_en: No spread filter may cause severe slippage in low-liquidity markets
Lack of position check may lead to repeated same-direction openings, amplifying risk exposure
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit distances are not self-adaptive to market volatility
